title: A promotion lands in a skill the run actually opened
action:
SOURCE OF TRUTH is `skills/bee-capturing/`; every `.claude/`, `.claude-plugin/`, `.codex-plugin/`, `.opencode/`, `.agents/` copy is a RENDER — never hand-edit one, `bee dev regen` writes them.

RED FIRST (D10, the Iron Law). Write 3 pressure scenarios into `docs/history/learning-loop-gaps/reports/red-llg-2.md`, run them against the CURRENT text, record verbatim rationalizations: (a) a Compound pass holds a durable finding whose target skill the run never opened — does the agent add a body line anyway; (b) the same finding, but the skill exists and clearly SHOULD have fired — does the agent reach for a description tune or a body edit; (c) an agent is told 'was this skill opened' should be a mechanical check — does it invent one from `affects_skills` or from the dispatch log. Each needs >= 3 combined pressures. Then the minimal edit, then re-run all three.

THE EDIT — a routing qualifier on Q3, NOT a fourth bar (D8). In `skills/bee-capturing/references/promotion.md`, the Promotion Decision Tree's Q3 reads (rg hits promotion.md:118-119) `3. Not mechanizable (judgment, taste, product intent) → promote as` / `   prose per the format below.` Extend that branch so prose has a routing rule: prose lands in a skill the run ACTUALLY OPENED; a skill that exists and should have fired but was never opened earns `tune description: <skill path>` — a description edit so it triggers next time — never a body edit. State the reason in one clause: text added to a skill nobody opens changes nothing. Say how 'opened' is judged from the run's own record (the skill's SKILL.md read, a dispatch naming it, or a command the skill documents), and that a finding routing to neither is filed as a learning rather than forced into a skill.

DO NOT touch the three bars at Q1 (`promotion.md:110-113`) — they are filters that can reject; this qualifier only decides where a promotion LANDS, and shelving a router among filters mis-teaches all four. For the same reason, `promotion.md:111`'s `all three promotion criteria` and `SKILL.md:123`'s `all three bars` both stay THREE (claim 17) — confirm with `rg -n 'all three' skills/bee-capturing/` before and after.

D9 — Q4 (rg hits promotion.md:124-127) already requires `prose survives only with a one-line recorded reason ... naming why no mechanical owner exists yet`. Write that reason for this rule where Q3's new text lives: nothing in `hooks/` records a Skill invocation, and the cell field `affects_skills` records which skills the work EDITS, a different fact — so no mechanical owner exists today.

SKILL.md BODY (the Regrowth law, `bee-writing-skills/SKILL.md:44`): the body's Compound step 4 (rg hit SKILL.md:123-128) already ends by pointing at the tree. Add at most ONE clause naming the routing rule so a Compound pass sees it exists — a rule the agent never sees is a rule nobody applies — and keep the substance in `promotion.md`. If one clause cannot carry it, leave the body alone and say so as a deviation.

Also file, with `bee backlog add`, the durable owner Q4 asks for: a hook or session-record field that stamps which skills a run opened, which would turn this prose rule into a mechanical check.

Then `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` and commit what it touched. Proof: the three RED scenarios re-run green, `rg -n 'all three' skills/bee-capturing/` still returns both lines unchanged, `bee dev regen` leaves no diff. Record that as the proof line.
